ads.headline: Low search interest signals opportunity for cheap CPCs on service keywords
actions: Target high-intent keywords like 'emergency plumber near me' while competition bids are down
Allocate full $25/day budget to lead generation campaigns focused on immediate service needs
Test location-based audiences in underserved markets where competitors likely aren't advertising
ads.source: Google Trends analysis - meta ads (18) vs facebook ads cost (0) showing seasonal dip

creative.headline: Unable to provide data-driven recommendations — Google Trends shows zero search volume
actions: Data limitation: All three tracked metrics (instagram reels views, content hook, facebook ads creative) returned 0-100 scores with no differentiation
Recommendation: Pull actual Instagram Insights data directly from @marcomarkets account (top posts by engagement rate, saves, shares, DMs generated) for accurate strategy
Note: Google Trends data is too broad for niche B2B content strategy — need native platform analytics instead
creative.source: Google Trends (insufficient for tactical content strategy) + no Instagram Insights data provided

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience

competitors.headline: No one is teaching service businesses HOW to respond to leads from ads
actions: Uncovered angle: competitors teach how to get leads but never what to say when the lead comes in — film 'exact script I tell my clients to use when someone fills in the form'
Pain point from this week: 'I got leads from my ads but none of them booked' — hook: 'You got leads but nobody booked. Here is exactly why and how to fix it in one message'
Top accounts posting 3-4x per week minimum with one Reel hitting 10k+ views acting as top of funnel — post volume is the differentiator right now
